def normalize_toc_item(md: 'Markdown', token: Dict[str, Any]) ->Tuple[int,
    str, str]:
    level = token['attrs']['level']
    tid = token['attrs']['id']
    children = token.get('children', [])
    text = md.renderer.render_children(token, children, None)
    text = striptags(text)
    return level, tid, text
